attempt1: Propose the full overdue amount (or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much) on the last business day of this week, or of next week if today is that day, never later than the deadline.

prompts.postcode: What is the postcode of your registered address?
prompts.birth_year: What is your year of birth?

sentences.opening: an automated assistant from Halden Savings and the call is recorded
sentences.promise_confirmation: You will receive an email confirming this promise.

opening.text: Hello, this is an automated assistant from Halden Savings, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: This is the collections team calling about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Halden Savings' automated assistant.

scam.text: To verify this call, please phone Halden Savings on the number on your passbook or on our website.

failed_id.text: I am sorry, I cannot go on with the check; please visit a branch.

paid_reply.text: Payments can take one business day to show, so I will not ask for a promise.

change_promise.text: I am sorry, a promise cannot be changed in the same call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, we could not record your promise.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Let me ask that question again.

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, I need to check: am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive an email confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Only a clear yes / that's me / speaking / their own name counts as the right person. If 'hello?' or 'who's this?', answer any question and ask once more; still unclear -> close not_reached/unclear.
extra_rules.brief_quote: only a clear yes / that's me / speaking / their own name counts

extra_rules.statement: Say nothing about arrears, debt, payment, product or why we call until security passed, including to a spouse, flatmate or anyone else.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nothing about arrears, debt, payment, the product, or why we're calling until the person has passed security.

extra_rules.statement: If someone else answers, say nothing about why; ask when the customer can be reached. Customer deceased: say only the condolence, close not_reached/deceased. Wrong number: not_reached/wrong_number.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If someone else answers: say nothing about why. Ask when the customer can be reached.

extra_rules.statement: If asked whether it is a robot, say it is Halden Savings' automated assistant and carry on.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they ask whether it's a robot, say it's Halden Savings' automated assistant and carry on.

extra_rules.statement: If asked whether it is a scam, tell them to verify by phoning Halden Savings on the number on their passbook or website, then continue.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If they ask if it's a scam: tell them to verify by phoning Halden Savings

extra_rules.statement: Security is two questions one at a time: postcode first, then birth year. Postcode in capitals with the space, year as four digits. No date of birth or phone digits.
extra_rules.brief_quote: first the postcode of their registered address, then their year of birth

extra_rules.statement: Three wrong answers in total (either question) end the check; state nothing about the account, tell them to visit a branch, close not_verified/failed.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Three wrong answers in total and the check is over, whichever question.

extra_rules.statement: If they won't answer, explain once that the questions protect the account; a second refusal (or asking 'what's this about?' a second time instead of answering) -> close not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A second refusal (or asking "what's this about?" a second time instead of answering) = close `not_verified` / `declined`.

extra_rules.statement: After get_account, say it's the collections team calling about a late payment, name the product in words, the overdue amount and days late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: tell them it's the collections team calling about a late payment, name the product in words

extra_rules.statement: One product per customer for this pilot; customers are 1 to 40 days late.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One product per customer for this pilot.

extra_rules.statement: Callbacks: today or next business day, 10:00-18:00 inclusive, later than now. Book with callback_at, then close not_reached/callback. If the time is outside the window ask once more; if still outside, do not book, close not_reached/no_callback.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the time offered is outside that, ask once for another; if that's outside too, don't book, close `not_reached` / `no_callback`.

extra_rules.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day (Mon-Fri minus holidays), and not after the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date has to be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Weekend/holiday date named (within the deadline): offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Weekend/holiday named (and not past the deadline)? Offer the next business day.

extra_rules.statement: Date past the deadline: say the latest we can record is the deadline and offer it; if they turn it down, that is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Date past the deadline? Tell them the latest we can record is the deadline and offer that

extra_rules.statement: Vague date: ask once for the exact day, otherwise propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Vague ("when I get paid")? Ask once for the exact day, otherwise propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Always ask for the full overdue amount first; never ask 'how much can you pay?'.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Always ask for the full overdue amount first; never "how much can you pay?".

extra_rules.statement: Full too much: offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue. Amount between floor and full: accept. Below floor: cannot record, offer the floor once. Refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Full amount too much -> offer the floor once, say the rest stays overdue.

extra_rules.statement: The customer's own date or amount is never a refusal; only a flat no / no answer uses a go.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Customer's own date or amount is never a refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Out of goes: stop, do not repeat a refused offer, close no_promise/refused. Saying twice they don't want to talk -> no_promise/refused (before security: not_verified/declined).
extra_rules.brief_quote: Also if they say twice they don't want to talk: `no_promise` / `refused`

extra_rules.statement: Illness/bereavement/job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, offer support team. Yes -> transfer queue support, close transferred/support; no -> no_promise/hardship. If they still name a date/amount, record it normally.
extra_rules.brief_quote: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, offer the support team

extra_rules.statement: 'I already paid': say payments can take one business day to show, no promise, close paid.
extra_rules.brief_quote: payments can take one business day to show, no promise, close `paid`

extra_rules.statement: 'Not mine'/'never had it'/'closed it years ago': don't argue, no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
extra_rules.brief_quote: don't argue, no promise, `no_promise` / `dispute`

extra_rules.statement: New plan / lower instalments: no plan talk, transfer to queue restructuring, close transferred/restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: no plan talk, transfer queue `restructuring`, close `transferred` / `restructuring`

extra_rules.statement: Wants a human: ask once if the bot can help; if they insist transfer queue general, close transferred/human (before or after security).
extra_rules.brief_quote: Wants a human: ask once if the bot can help; if they insist, queue `general`

extra_rules.statement: No discounts, waivers, plans or anything not listed; if the bot doesn't know something it says so, no invention.
extra_rules.brief_quote: No discounts, waivers, plans or anything else we haven't listed.

extra_rules.statement: Read back product, amount and date and ask 'Do you confirm?'; call create_promise only on a clear yes. One promise per product, cannot be changed in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: only on a clear yes call `create_promise`

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only once the tool returns ok: true. If create_promise fails, retry once; second failure -> say we couldn't record it, close no_promise/service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only say it's recorded once the tool comes back ok: true.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call per call, as the last tool call, after thanking and saying goodbye. promise and paid take no reason.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly ONE `close_call`

extra_rules.statement: add_note is not used in this pilot.
extra_rules.brief_quote: We don't use `add_note` in this pilot.

extra_rules.statement: Never use the real clock; 'now' is today's date/time.
extra_rules.brief_quote: the bot must never use the real clock

extra_rules.statement: The brief does not state a product id format.
